hero.title: Report a Problem. Track the Action.
hero.subtitle: See what happens to your complaint from the moment you report it until the issue is resolved.

howItWorks.title: What happened to your complaint?
howItWorks.subtitle: Follow every important step from reporting a problem to verifying its resolution.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Citizen submits problem with photo, address & GPS location.
howItWorks.step2Desc: System logs ticket and assigns a unique NAG ID in the public ledger.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Routed to designated municipal engineering wing & field officer with SLA.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Assigned officer visits the site, prepares indent, and commences repairs.
howItWorks.step5Desc: Official attaches mandatory before/after photo proof of work done.
howItWorks.step6Desc: Department marks work completed with official resolution remarks.
howItWorks.step7Desc: Citizen verifies on ground: confirms fix with 5 stars or reopens with photo.

commonProblems.title: Common Civic Problems
commonProblems.subtitle: Select a category below to report an issue with standard municipal resolution SLAs.

whyNagarSetu.title: Why NagarSetu?
whyNagarSetu.subtitle: NagarSetu means a bridge between citizens and civic services. It eliminates the municipal black hole by ensuring that every complaint has clear ownership, immutable visual timelines, and citizen-verified outcomes.
whyNagarSetu.card1Desc: Know the exact department, officer name, and contact details responsible for your issue.
whyNagarSetu.card2Desc: Every action, inspection, and status transition is recorded with timestamped audit logs.
whyNagarSetu.card3Desc: Officials must upload genuine on-ground before and after photos before marking resolved.
whyNagarSetu.card4Desc: You have the final say. If the issue is not fixed, reopen it and it auto-escalates to supervisors.
